svg.title: Trace one Cargo flow signal from the model to the historian
svg.desc: Worked arithmetic example, not a live sample. A model flowMeasured value of 0.5 cubic metres per second becomes raw input register 2 equal to 1800. A Modbus function 04 read carries the register to AI_Flow_m3h. The PLC converts the integer to real Flow_m3h without multiplying by 3600 again. Live OPC UA discovery binds that symbol to the HMI and historian.
svg.text: One signal • exact repository mapping • worked values, not a captured run
The process API uses cubic metres per second.
Input register 2 • zero-based address • Unit ID 1 • cargo-io:5020
INT_TO_REAL changes the type. The I/O layer already converted the units.
Browse the running OPC UA server; record its actual NodeId
Value + unit + Quality + timestamp must agree with the source.
A plausible value with bad Quality or an old timestamp is not a fresh measurement.
If the process API shows 0.5 and the PLC shows 1800, are they disagreeing?
No: 0.5 m³/s × 3600 s/h = 1800 m³/h. Always compare units first.
